talents.name: Wand Specialization
ranks: Increases your damage with Wands by 13%.
Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

talents.name: Improved Channeling
talents.summary: Interrupt protection: Arcane Missiles 20-100%, Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath 14-70%
ranks: Gives your Arcane Missiles spell a 20% chance and your Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath spells a 14% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.
Gives your Arcane Missiles spell a 40% chance and your Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath spells a 28% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.
Gives your Arcane Missiles spell a 60% chance and your Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath spells a 42% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.
Gives your Arcane Missiles spell a 80% chance and your Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath spells a 56% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.
Gives your Arcane Missiles spell a 100% chance and your Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Arcane Resilience
ranks: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 25% of your Intellect.
Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 50% of your Intellect.
Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 75% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Arcane Subtlety
ranks: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 8 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 15%.
Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%.

talents.name: Magic Absorption
talents.summary: All resistances +5/10; 1/2% mana restored on full resists
ranks: Increases all your resistances by 5 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 1% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.
Increases all your resistances by 10 and causes all spells you fully resist to restore 2% of your total mana. Cannot trigger more often than 1 time per sec.

talents.name: Arcane Concentration
ranks: Gives you a 2% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.
Gives you a 4% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.
Gives you a 6% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.
Gives you a 8% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.
Gives you a 10% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

talents.name: Missile Barrage
talents.summary: Chance for free, faster Arcane Missiles: 20/40% from Arcane Blast, 10/20% from other listed spells
ranks: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 20% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 10% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.

Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Arcane Geometry
ranks: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 3 yards.
Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 6 yards.

talents.name: Arcane Impact
ranks: Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 2%.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 4%.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Arcane spells by 6%.

talents.name: Arcane Blast
talents.cost: 15% of base mana | 30 yd range | 1.5 sec cast
ranks: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 34 to 38 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, you gain 12% of your Intellect as Spell Damage and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 100%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 18 sec from time of initial application.

talents.name: Arcane Shielding
talents.summary: Mana Shield mana loss -17/33%; Mage Armor resistances +25/50%
ranks: Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 17% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 25%.
Decreases the Mana lost per point of damage taken when your Mana Shield spell is active by 33% and increases the resistances granted by your Mage Armor spell by 50%.

talents.name: Improved Counterspell
ranks: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 2 sec.
Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 4 sec.

talents.name: Arcane Meditation
talents.summary: 17/33/50% of mana regen continues while casting
ranks: Allows 17% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
Allows 33% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Arcane Wrath
talents.cost: 140 Mana | 30 yd range | 3.5 sec cast | 6 sec cooldown
ranks: Launches a projectile of pure Arcane energy at the enemy target, causing 122 to 146 Arcane damage. This spell gains additional Spell Damage equal to 5% of your maximum Mana.

talents.name: Presence of Mind
talents.summary: Next spell with a cast under 10 sec becomes instant
ranks: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

Increases the damage done by your spells by 3% and your critical strike chance by 3%.

talents.name: Arcane Power
talents.summary: 30% more spell damage and 30% more mana cost for 15 sec
ranks: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

Reduces the casting time of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, and Arcane Wrath spells by 0.2 sec.
Reduces the casting time of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, and Arcane Wrath spells by 0.3 sec.
Reduces the casting time of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, and Arcane Wrath spells by 0.4 sec.
Reduces the casting time of your Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, and Arcane Wrath spells by 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Pyroblast
ranks: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 101 to 131 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec.

talents.name: Improved Fire Blast
talents.summary: Fire Blast cooldown -1/2 sec; range +8/15 yd
ranks: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 1 sec and increases its range by 8 yards.
Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec and increases its range by 15 yards.

talents.name: Improved Scorch
talents.summary: 33/67/100% chance for Scorch to apply a stacking +3% Fire damage taken (up to 5)
ranks: Your Scorch spell has a 33% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

Your Scorch spell has a 67% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

Your Scorch spell has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.summary: Fire Ward has a 10/20% chance to reflect Fire spells
ranks: Causes your Fire Ward to have a 10% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.
Causes your Fire Ward to have a 20% chance to reflect Fire spells while active.

talents.name: Heating Up
talents.summary: Crits shorten the next Pyroblast cast by 25% per stack, up to 3
ranks: Non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. Fire Blast grants an additional stack every time it deals damage.

talents.name: Master of Elements
talents.summary: Fire and Frost crits refund 10/20/30% of the spell's base mana cost
ranks: Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 10% of their base mana cost.
Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 20% of their base mana cost.
Your Fire and Frost critical strikes will refund 30% of their base mana cost.

ranks: Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 2%.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 4%.
Increases the critical strike chance of your Fire spells by 6%.

talents.name: Blast Wave
ranks: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 154 to 184 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

talents.name: Fire Power
talents.summary: Fire damage +1/2/3% per Fire effect on the target (caps at 4/8/12%)
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 1% per your Fire effects on the target, up to a maximum increase of 4%. Effects which mix multiple schools of magic do not qualify.
Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 2% per your Fire effects on the target, up to a maximum increase of 8%. Effects which mix multiple schools of magic do not qualify.
Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 3% per your Fire effects on the target, up to a maximum increase of 12%. Effects which mix multiple schools of magic do not qualify.

talents.name: Combustion
talents.summary: Fire crit chance +10% until 3 non-periodic Fire crits
ranks: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

talents.name: Frost Warding
talents.summary: Frost Armor and Ice Armor +15/30%; Frost Ward and Ice Barrier improved
ranks: Increases the Armor and resistances granted by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 15%, gives your Frost Ward a 10% chance to negate the warded damage spell, and increases the amount absorbed by your Ice Barrier and Frost Ward by 10%.

Increases the Armor and resistances granted by your Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by 30%, gives your Frost Ward a 20% chance to negate the warded damage spell, and increases the amount absorbed by your Ice Barrier and Frost Ward by 20%.

talents.name: Ice Lance
talents.cost: 45 Mana | 30 yd range | Instant | 8 sec cooldown
ranks: Deals 28 to 32 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.

talents.name: Arctic Reach
talents.summary: Range and radius of listed Frost spells +10/20%
ranks: Increases the range of your Frostbolt, Ice Lance, and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 10%.
Increases the range of your Frostbolt, Ice Lance, and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 20%.

talents.name: Ice Block
ranks: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

talents.name: Shatter
ranks: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 17%.
Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 33%.
Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 50%.

talents.name: Improved Cone of Cold

Increases the damage dealt by your Cone of Cold spell by 23%.

talents.name: Cold Snap

talents.name: Fingers of Frost

talents.summary: 20/40/60/80/100% chance to apply stacking Winter's Chill, boosting your Frost damage
ranks: Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 20% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 40% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 60% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.name: Ice Barrier
ranks: Shield yourself, absorbing 447 damage and increasing your Frost damage by 15% for 1 min. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 5% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.
